entries.name: Chainsword
entries.description: Malum Caedo's starting weapon: horizontal serrated attacks that hit several enemies. The Steam page lists an 'Astartes Chainsword' in the arsenal (assumed to be the same weapon).

entries.name: Lasgun
entries.description: Fires at the nearest enemy; levelling it adds Cadian squadmates. Taking it as another champion recruits Trooper Kozlowski.

entries.name: Boltgun
entries.description: Brother Luca's starting weapon, powerful enough to blast Termagants apart.

entries.name: Whirlwind Battery
entries.description: Rains missiles down from above (IGN hands-on). Officially evolves into Orbital Bombardment.

entries.name: Power Fists
entries.description: Crushes xenos threats. Evolving it brings Marneus Calgar to your side, wielding the Gauntlets of Ultramar and firing bolter rounds with every attack.

entries.name: Frag Grenade
entries.description: The Legend of Catachan's base weapon, hurled liberally. Frag Grenades also exist as a pick-up.

entries.name: Heavy Bolter Fidelis
entries.description: Morvenn Vahl's weapon: sprays an arc of projectiles, with a chance to trigger a miracle that increases its rate of fire.

entries.name: Tempest Axes
entries.description: Neave Blacktalon's starting weapon in the October demo.

entries.name: Grandblade
entries.description: Sharynn Azurwrath's starting blade; levelling it up unleashes a huge circular swing.

entries.name: Fyrestorm Greataxe
entries.description: Swings around the player in a brutal arc, gaining speed and strength and changing direction as you move. Stops once a certain amount of damage is dealt; standing idle reduces its damage.

entries.name: Brazier Staff
entries.description: Ulgromthier's staff, firing arcing magma projectiles.

entries.name: Rope and Grapnel
entries.description: Lyssa Revenya's tools: hooks fly in from random screen edges, hit points on the battlefield, damage enemies and drag away survivors; weaker foes are often killed instantly.

entries.name: Uskavar the Sunderer
entries.description: Bastian Carthalos's weapon, pulverising enemies in specific close-range patterns.

entries.name: Nebulous Sea Fog
entries.description: Conjured by Lorai to draw foes in and damage them.

entries.name: Boltstorm Pistol
entries.description: Age of Sigmar pistol listed in the October demo evolution report.

entries.name: Nuln Oil
entries.description: Cross-universe weapon that douses foes in black wash. Survivors are slowed and become vulnerable to fire (the Oiled status), so it combos with Burning weapons.

entries.name: D6 Dice
entries.description: Cross-universe weapon usable by both 40K and AoS characters. Large dice fly in from off-screen and explode depending on the number rolled (IGN hands-on).

entries.name: Eviscerator Chainsword
entries.description: Reported evolution of the Chainsword with the Tape Measure passive. Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Meltagun
entries.description: Reported evolution of the Lasgun with the Gauntlet passive. Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Heavy Bolter
entries.description: Evolved Boltgun: a stream of unrelenting firepower against the toughest swarms and larger bioforms. Community report pairs it with Dice Cube.

entries.name: Orbital Bombardment
entries.description: Brings down barrages of voidship fire from above; the evolution of the Whirlwind Battery. Community report pairs it with Liquid Green Stuff.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Ultramar
entries.description: Power Fists evolution: Marneus Calgar joins you and unleashes a hail of bolter rounds with every attack.

entries.name: Ripper Pistol
entries.description: Officially an unlockable weapon for the Legend of Catachan. A community report lists it as the Frag Grenade + Bandolier evolution, granted as a bonus poisoned pistol rather than replacing the grenades.

entries.name: Purgator Mirabilis
entries.description: Fidelis evolution that unlocks the Paragon Missile Launcher: sporadic salvos of explosions on top of the bolter spray.

entries.name: Whirlwind Axes
entries.description: Lightning-infused axes. IGN evolved them from Tempest Axes by levelling the Sabaton passive. Listed on the Steam page.

entries.name: Zangrom-Thaz
entries.description: Gotrek's axe, gained by evolving the Fyrestorm Greataxe; calls Gotrek to your side. Swings constantly, and speeds up as you charge into enemies.

entries.name: Ghost of Rhea
entries.description: Rope and Grapnel evolution: the screaming banshee spirit of Rhea soars across the battlefield and explodes into damaging ghostly fog. Community report pairs it with White Dwarf.

entries.name: Master of Runes
entries.description: Reported evolution of the Brazier Staff with Liquid Green Stuff. Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Aquatic Illusions
entries.description: Reported evolution of Nebulous Sea Fog with Bugman's Tankard (May demo list said Glue). Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Typhoon Crossbow
entries.description: Reported evolution of the Boltstorm Pistol with Dice Cube. Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Mordant Earth
entries.description: Reported evolution of Nuln Oil with Hourglass, listed in both universes. Effect pending launch.

entries.name: Sabaton
entries.description: Passive that makes your character faster; required for the Tempest Axes evolution in IGN's run.

entries.name: Tape Measure
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Gauntlet
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Dice Cube
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Liquid Green Stuff
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Bandolier
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: White Dwarf
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Hourglass
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Bugman's Tankard
entries.description: Evolution companion named in the October demo community report. Stat effect pending launch.

entries.name: Melta-Bomb
entries.description: Powerful grenade pick-up: after a short delay it unleashes a blast of thermal energy, so you can kite mobs into its radius.

entries.name: Blast Template
entries.description: Lands on screen and triggers a massive explosion that destroys all enemies on screen; some enemies resist insta-kill effects.

entries.name: Hellfire Ammo
entries.description: Temporarily increases the damage of all ranged attacks and inflicts Poisoned.

entries.name: Purple Sun of Shyish
entries.description: Endless Spell that, once manifested, creates damaging zones that hit anything in its light — including you.

entries.name: Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
entries.description: Tethers to you and chomps nearby enemies as you move, dealing damage and applying Burning.

entries.name: Suffocating Gravetide
entries.description: Stuns all enemies caught, then sends them fleeing temporarily.

entries.name: Frenzon
entries.description: Grants the Berserk status, increasing the frequency of weapon attacks.
